## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record the relevant checks and any remaining limitations.

## Review gate

Follow [the mandatory review gate](../docs/operations/pull-request-review-gate.md).

- [ ] Configured review completed for the final head.
- [ ] Every substantive finding has a commit or current-code explanation and validation linked in its original thread.
- [ ] Review threads resolved only after evidence was recorded.
- [ ] Relevant CI and security checks pass for the final head.
- [ ] Head SHA and unresolved threads refreshed immediately before merge.
